trans-unit.source: Dude, you've become an ass-kicking machine.
trans-unit.target: Dude, you've become an ass-kicking machine.

trans-unit.source: Hard to believe the boars always chased YOU around!
trans-unit.target: Hard to believe the boars always chased YOU around!

trans-unit.source: H-hey! That's when we were kids!
trans-unit.target: H-hey! That's when we were kids!

trans-unit.source: Remember how you woke the dead when a caterpillar climbed in your shirt?
trans-unit.target: Remember how you woke the dead when a caterpillar climbed in your shirt?

trans-unit.source: Oho! Good to know he hasn't changed at all!
trans-unit.target: Oho! Good to know he hasn't changed at all!

trans-unit.source: How I weep for the future of Euclid...
trans-unit.target: How I weep for the future of Euclid...

trans-unit.source: ...if these two are its mightiest men...
trans-unit.target: ...if these two are its mightiest men...
